idea: Questions: lifts haven't moved in a month
caption: be honest with number 2

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: questions to ask if your lifts haven't moved in a month

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 1. are you doing the same exercises, with the same setup, each week?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 2. do you know what you lifted last time, or are you guessing?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 3. are you aiming for one more rep, or just repeating last week?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text: 4. are you getting your planned sessions in, even if you move the days?

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text: 5. are you sleeping and eating enough to recover?
questions 2 and 3 are what EARND answers on every exercise: last session and today's target.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
know your last session. know your target.
